summary: @ornikar/kitt2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime release from github.com/oven-sh/bun, extracts the binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~728 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (rotated index table `n7gIxM`, single-letter hex-named globals reconstructing all strings/URLs at runtime). The obfuscated payload is unrelated to the package's declared surface: `dist/index-node-22.17.es.mjs` is ~700 bytes of React/Tamagui/Storybook decorator glue exporting `Kitt2Decorator`/`Kitt2Provider`. The package name `@ornikar/kitt2` shadows the legitimate `@ornikar/kitt` scope. The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern (fetching a second runtime to execute an opaque bundle) evades Node-based scanners; the cover-story mismatch between the tiny library surface and the large obfuscated preinstall payload is characteristic of impersonation droppers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
